mapper.select: SELECT tb_dictionary_item.id, tb_dictionary_item.type_id, tb_dictionary_item.name, tb_dictionary_item.`value`, tb_dictionary_item.sort, tb_dictionary_item.is_default, tb_dictionary_item.status, tb_dictionary_item.gmt_created, tb_dictionary_item.gmt_modified FROM tb_dictionary_type LEFT JOIN tb_dictionary_item ON tb_dictionary_item.type_id = tb_dictionary_type.id WHERE tb_dictionary_type.code = #{code}

SELECT tb_dictionary_item.id, tb_dictionary_item.type_id, tb_dictionary_item.name, tb_dictionary_item.`value`, tb_dictionary_item.sort, tb_dictionary_item.is_default, tb_dictionary_item.status, tb_dictionary_item.gmt_created, tb_dictionary_item.gmt_modified FROM tb_dictionary_type LEFT JOIN tb_dictionary_item ON tb_dictionary_item.type_id = tb_dictionary_type.id WHERE tb_dictionary_type.code = #{type} AND tb_dictionary_item.value = #{value}
